# FeedyRuby Operator Admin Panel — Review Report

## 1. Overall verdict

**Sound and production-ready once the fixes below are applied. No BLOCKERs.**

The panel's core security model is solid: every `/admin` page awaits `requireSuperAdmin()` and every route handler self-gates via `getSuperAdminSession()` before any query runs. Access is gated entirely by the `SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS` env allowlist, and the primary revocation control (removing an email from the env) genuinely works. Cross-tenant reads are read-only. No tenant-data leak, no isolation break, no injection, no auth-bypass survived verification.

The one security item worth doing before deploy is defense-in-depth (`isActive` check) — it is **low**, not a blocker, because the primary control still revokes access. Everything else is correctness/perf/UX/hygiene, none of which threatens data integrity or isolation.

The performance findings, while real, are all scoped to a super-admin-only, low-traffic operator tool and only bite "at millions of rows" — the team already documented and accepted this tradeoff in `IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW.md`. Treat them as scaling hygiene, not launch gates.

## 2. Findings by severity (deduplicated)

### MEDIUM

**[medium] `apps/web/modules/admin/lib/queries.ts:27` — `getInstanceOverview` runs 6 uncached full/filtered counts + a 90-day `findMany` on every force-dynamic load; `createdAt`/`lastLoginAt`/`emailVerified` are unindexed.**
Fix: wrap `getInstanceOverview` in `unstable_cache` with `revalidate: 300` (operator totals need not be live-to-the-second); add `@@index([createdAt])` on `User` (shared with the users-list fix); optionally index `lastLoginAt`/`emailVerified` or fold them into the cached snapshot. At very large scale, swap exact `response.count()` for a `pg_class.reltuples` estimate.

### LOW

**[low] `apps/web/modules/admin/lib/auth.ts:33` — Super-admin gate never checks `user.isActive`, so a deactivated operator whose email is still in the allowlist keeps full cross-tenant read/export access until redeploy.** *(security, defense-in-depth)*
Fix: after the email check, treat inactive as unauthorized — in `getSuperAdminSession()` return `null` when `session.user.isActive === false`; in `requireSuperAdmin()` `redirect("/continue")` (or `notFound()`, see nit below) for the inactive case. `isActive` is already on the session (`authOptions.ts:433`, database strategy) so the signal is live and free.

**[low] `apps/web/modules/admin/lib/queries.ts:85` (+ `:156`, and both export routes) — `contains`/`mode:insensitive` compiles to leading-wildcard `ILIKE '%q%'` with no trigram index → full seq scan of `User`/`Organization` on each search (and over `pageSize:5000` on export).** *(perf)*
Fix: `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;` then GIN indexes `USING gin (lower(email) gin_trgm_ops)` on `User.email`, `User.name`, `Organization.name`. Or switch admin search to `startsWith` (btree-servable) if leading-substring match isn't required. *(Note: the finding's reference to `User_email_idx` is stale — that index was dropped in migration `20260113160531`; the point stands via the remaining unique index.)*

**[low] `apps/web/modules/admin/lib/queries.ts:95` — Users-list `orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }` + `skip/take` has no supporting `createdAt` index → full-table sort on the default (no-search) `/admin/users` load.** *(perf; index shared with the Overview fix)*
Fix: `@@index([createdAt(sort: Desc)])` on `User` → `CREATE INDEX "User_created_at_idx" ON "User"("created_at" DESC);`.

**[low] `apps/web/modules/admin/lib/queries.ts:260` — `getOrganizationDetail` loads all workspaces + all surveys (with per-survey `_count.responses`) for an org with no pagination; unbounded fan-out for an outlier tenant, re-run every visit (force-dynamic).** *(perf)*
Fix: add `take` (e.g. top 200 surveys by `createdAt` with a "showing N of M" note) and/or paginate per workspace; bound the workspaces query.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/export/users/route.ts:18` (+ `organizations/route.ts:18`) — Export buffers up to 5000 fully-hydrated rows in memory, non-streaming; the org export additionally fans out to survey `findMany` + response `groupBy` over every workspace/survey of 5000 orgs.** *(perf)*
Fix: for orgs, compute totals with one grouped SQL aggregation (`Workspace→Survey→Response GROUP BY organizationId`) instead of pulling every id through the app and grouping in JS; consider a streaming `ReadableStream` with keyset pagination in ~500-row chunks so memory stays flat.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/page.tsx:6` — No `loading.tsx`/Suspense anywhere under `app/(admin)/`; force-dynamic pages block on the DB round-trip before any markup streams, so navigation shows the frozen previous route or a blank frame with no feedback.** *(ui-ux)*
Fix: add `app/(admin)/admin/loading.tsx` (and per-route loaders for users/organizations/[orgId]) with a lightweight skeleton, or wrap each data region in `<Suspense fallback={<Skeleton/>}>`.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/components/table-controls.tsx:14` — Search `<input name="q">` has no accessible name (placeholder only), no `type="search"`.** *(a11y)*
Fix: `<input name="q" type="search" aria-label={placeholder} ... />`.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/components/signups-chart.tsx:8` — Recharts `AreaChart` has no `role`/`aria-label`/`<title>`/data-table fallback and no `accessibilityLayer`; the 90-day series is inaccessible.** *(a11y)*
Fix: wrap in `role="img"` with an `aria-label` summarizing the series (and total), add `accessibilityLayer` to the chart, and/or render a visually-hidden date→count table.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/components/admin-nav.tsx:18` — Fixed `w-56 shrink-0` sidebar with zero responsive classes; on a 375px phone it consumes 224px and crushes the data tables into ~151px.** *(ui-ux; acceptable if desktop-only is the product stance)*
Fix: `hidden md:flex` on the aside plus a small-screen top bar/menu toggle, or make the shell `flex-col md:flex-row`.

**[low] `apps/web/modules/admin/lib/queries.ts:40` — Signups chart off-by-one: buckets seeded for `i=0..89` (oldest = `now-89d`) but `recent` fetched with `createdAt >= now-90d`, so signups in `[now-90d, now-89d)` pass the filter but are dropped by the `buckets.has(k)` guard; the earliest data point under-reports.** *(correctness)*
Fix: seed 91 buckets (`for (let i = 0; i <= 90; i++)`) **or** fetch with `createdAt >= now-89*864e5`. `newUsers30d` is unaffected.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/components/table-controls.tsx:42` — Pagination footer shows nonsensical range when `page` exceeds total pages (e.g. `?page=9999` with 50 rows → "249951–50 of 50", "Page 9999 / 2"); query is fine, display isn't.** *(correctness)*
Fix: clamp before display — `const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total/pageSize)); const p = Math.min(Math.max(1, page), totalPages);` and derive from/to and the "Page x/y" label from `p`.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/organizations/[orgId]/page.tsx:118` — Org-detail survey response counts render raw (`{s.responses}` → "12345") while every other count uses `Intl.NumberFormat("en-US")`; visible list-vs-detail inconsistency.** *(ui-ux)*
Fix: add `const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US")` and render `{nf.format(s.responses)}`.

**[low] `apps/web/app/(admin)/IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW.md:1` — Design/review doc shipped inside the `app/(admin)` route group (only `.md` under `app/`, convention outlier; not routable, harmless).** *(conventions)*
Fix: move to PR description or repo `docs/`/`.github/`, or delete, before merge; keep `app/(admin)` to route files + `components/`.

### NIT

**[nit] `apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/organizations/[orgId]/page.tsx:21` — Dead `s === "scheduled"` branch in `surveyType`; `SurveyStatus` enum has only `draft|inProgress|paused|completed`.** Unreachable, and removing it is behavior-neutral (both paths yield `"info"`). *(Leftover from removed survey-scheduling, dropped in migration `20250904145727` — not a phantom status.)*
Fix: drop the `|| s === "scheduled"` clause.

**[nit] `apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/export/users/route.ts:10` (+ `organizations/route.ts:10`) — `esc()` trigger regex `/[",\n]/` omits `\r`; a field with a lone CR is emitted unquoted and can be mis-split by a strict RFC-4180 CR-terminator parser.** *(correctness)*
Fix: `/[",\r\n]/`.

**[nit] `apps/web/app/(admin)/admin/users/page.tsx:68` — Email/name/org cells render raw with no truncation (unlike the sidebar's `truncate ... title={email}`); a long unbroken value stretches columns.** Overflow is already contained to a local scrollbar inside the table card (not the page), so purely cosmetic. *(ui-ux)*
Fix: `max-w-[22rem] truncate` + `title={u.email}` on the free-text cells (email/name/org, and org-list owner email).

**[nit] `apps/web/modules/admin/lib/auth.ts:36` — Authenticated non-super-admins get `redirect("/continue")` rather than `notFound()`, faintly confirming `/admin` exists.** No data leaks (redirect fires before any query); `/continue` is the app's generic authenticated entry resolver, so it's a weak oracle at best. *(security, informational)*
Fix (optional): `notFound()` for the not-a-super-admin branch; keep `redirect("/auth/login")` for the unauthenticated branch.

**[nit] `apps/web/app/(admin)/components/table-controls.tsx:3` — Exports a `SearchBar` (uncontrolled server GET-form) colliding by name with `modules/ui/components/search-bar/index.tsx`'s controlled `value`/`onChange` `SearchBar`.** Separate trees, no shared barrel, mismatched props fail at compile time — pure naming hygiene. *(conventions)*
Fix: rename to `AdminSearchBar`.

## 3. Merges applied

- **Index for `User.createdAt`** is the shared fix for both the Overview finding (`queries.ts:27`) and the users-list sort finding (`queries.ts:95`) — add the index once; it serves both.
- **Two "dead `scheduled` branch" findings** (`[orgId]/page.tsx:21` and `:26`) are the same defect at one `surveyType` helper — merged into one nit.
- **CSV `esc()` CR-quoting** and **export in-memory/fan-out** findings each span both `export/users` and `export/organizations` routes — reported once with both paths noted.
- **ILIKE trigram** and **`createdAt` sort** are distinct index gaps (trigram GIN vs btree) and kept separate, but both live in the same search/list query path.

---

## 4. Explicitly checked and OK

- **Auth / isolation (primary control):** every `/admin` page awaits `requireSuperAdmin()`; every route handler self-gates via `getSuperAdminSession()` → 403 before any query. Gate is the `SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS` allowlist (case-insensitive); removing an email revokes access. No tenant-data leak — guards fire before queries run.
- **Unauthenticated access:** redirects to `/auth/login` (no 404-vs-redirect leak that matters).
- **Cross-tenant writes:** none — panel is entirely read-only + CSV export.
- **`?page=1.5` float crash (rejected FP):** verified empirically against Prisma 7.8.0 + real Postgres — float `skip` is accepted/rounded, does **not** throw. Only an absurd `page≈1e21` int64 overflow crashes, behind the admin gate — genuine but a narrow hardening nit, not the described high-severity crash.
- **Org-detail sequential awaits (rejected FP):** the survey query has a real data dependency on `workspaceIds` from the org fetch — correctly not `Promise.all`-able; non-issue.
- **`getOrganizationsPage` N+1:** clean — single `survey.findMany` + single `response.groupBy` with in-memory Map aggregation for the whole page.
- **`newUsers30d`:** unaffected by the signups off-by-one (uses its own `>= since30` compare).
- **Per-survey response `_count`:** supported by `Response @@index([surveyId, createdAt])` — the count itself is fine; only the unbounded fan-out is the concern.
- **CSV injection/quoting:** `"` and `,` and `\n` are correctly escaped/quoted; only bare `\r` is the residual gap (nit above).

Both rejected false-positives were re-checked and the rejections are correct.
